extras.title: Everything you might pay, plainly
extras.desc: These come out of your store wallet in dollars, and you top it up in Egyptian pounds.
extras.topUpBody: From {topUpMin} to {topUpMax}, paid in EGP. On the free plan, a first {topUpMin} top-up is needed before you can see orders and send campaigns.
extras.appsBody: Some apps have a small cost, shown in your dashboard before you turn them on. One is Order Notifications, which sends customer order emails. It's optional and set per store.
extras.emailsBody: You can buy more once your monthly allowance runs out. You see the price in your dashboard before you buy.
extras.creditsBody: You see the price in your dashboard before you buy. Credits you buy never expire.
extras.processingBody: If you connect your Paymob or Kashier account, the gateway charges its fees to you directly.
extras.shippingBody: Tallaby doesn't deliver. You pay your shipping company or riders directly.

faq.title: Pricing questions
faq.desc: Can't find your answer? <link>Message us on WhatsApp.</link>

items.q: What does an order cost on the free plan?
items.a: {orderFee} per created order, whatever its value. No monthly fee and no percentage.

items.q: Is the free plan completely free?
items.a: There's no subscription and no card to start. You do need a first {topUpMin} top-up before you can see orders and send campaigns, and {orderFee} per order comes out of your wallet.
From about {breakEven} orders a month, the flat {pro} costs less than per-order fees. Pro also gives you {proCredits} AI credits.

items.q: Do my customers get order emails automatically?
items.a: Only with the Order Notifications app on. It's off by default, and you see its cost in your dashboard before you turn it on.
Each AI action, like preparing a product from photos or text, uses one credit. Credits are shared across your whole account, not per team member.

items.q: How do I pay in dollars from Egypt?
items.a: You choose a top-up in dollars, from {topUpMin} to {topUpMax}, and pay it in Egyptian pounds. You see the EGP amount before you pay.
